current.text: He is a backup big behind Chet Holmgren and Isaiah Hartenstein. He barely played unless one of those centers was out.
OKC's frontcourt is crowded. Al Horford re-signed, and Adimara and Thomas Sorber also compete for big man minutes.
He is the expert's preferred stash among OKC's backup bigs, ahead of Adimara.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a heel injury.
OKC has a league-minimum 13 back-to-backs. Its schedule is good with a March 28 end date.

durable.text: He is a very good passer for a big man and has become a good shooter.
He put up several triple-doubles when Chet Holmgren and Isaiah Hartenstein were out.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both rank him 231 with 0 USD value. Our league drafts only 144 players, so he should go undrafted. His projection is a low-volume bench line: about 6.7 points and 5.4 rebounds on 42% FG, with few turnovers as the only plus. Leave him on waivers, check his heel early, and pick him up right away if Chet Holmgren or Isaiah Hartenstein misses time, because his passing then gives him real value.
